'''Duane Bruun''' was a PC staff writer for the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="yearend">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030613110815/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/duane2002yearend.htm The State Of SWCCG], Duane Bruun (PC Staff Writer), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 13 June 2003.</ref> He wrote the 2002 year-end column "The State Of SWCCG".<ref name="yearend" /> He wrote "Interview With The Advocates", hosted by [[Game Players Network|GPN]], with [[Andrew Howard]], [[Eric Olson]] and [[Doug Taylor]]; the Committee listed it among its recommended articles on 4 December 2002.<ref name="dec02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/december02archives.htm December 02 Updates], swccgpc.com (4 December 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221911/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/december02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In May 2003 he wrote "The Evolution of Virtual Cards" (21 May) and its part 2 (27 May), on the design and playtesting of [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time|Virtual Set 5]]; both carried Virtual Set 5 spoilers.<ref name="evo1">[http://swccgpc.com/News/duaneevolution05212003.htm The Evolution of Virtual Cards], Duane Bruun, swccgpc.com (21 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030613013726/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/duaneevolution05212003.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="evo2">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/duaneevolution05272003.htm The Evolution of Virtual Cards (part 2)], Duane Bruun, swccgpc.com (27 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030809102440/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/duaneevolution05272003.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="may03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/may03archives.htm May 03 Updates], swccgpc.com (27 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031229115404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/may03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> His idea for a Dark Side effect matching Star Destroyers with their pilots was reworded by Taylor and became [[Alert My Star Destroyer! (V)]].<ref name="evo1" /> He was Shadow 47, in Bloomington-Normal, Illinois, on the Shadow Squadron rosters of 23 April 2003 and 4 June 2004.<ref name="vol2003">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 23 April 2003.</ref><ref name="vol2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040604020531/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 4 June 2004.</ref>
